notes: Evidence does not give ratios, reinsurance or solvency details; title insurance is not a P&C combined-ratio business in the usual sense.

insurance_business_line.value: Title insurance and related real estate settlement services (residential and commercial)

risk_underwriting_distribution_model.value: Title underwriter issuing policies through direct operations and a network of independent policy-issuing agents, plus settlement and escrow services

premium_exposure_mix.value: Real estate transaction-driven title premiums across residential and commercial transactions, serving lenders, agents and buyers

combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Not a P&C combined-ratio business; title insurance is assessed through policy loss provisions rather than a combined ratio
